_meta._note: Chapter 69, Final test (ch69-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions at 80 % (9/12 fails, 10/12 passes): a request and its consequence, and a response against a separate statement (q01–02), the direct command against the jussive response (q03–04), the response signs for a five form and a weak letter (q05–06), the Quran: 33:71 and the 2:282 look-alike (q07–08), a separate statement and a prohibition licensing a result (q09–10), and one decision from each surah (q11–12). Correct options are placed 3 / 3 / 3 / 3. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 9 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-69-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.
